primary_hypothesis.text: On hidden-cause development tasks, full Self-ORION produces greater protected improvement on independent fresh tasks than the strongest matched self-edit/self-evolution baseline while harmful-transfer rate remains within the frozen safety margin.

secondary_hypotheses.text: Competing causes plus a frozen discriminator reduce false method changes versus recurrence/reflection or candidate-centric optimization.
Protected assurance prevents evaluator, holdout and negative-history manipulation from being counted as improvement.
Fresh-transfer and integrity gains remain decision-useful after accounting for added compute/time and conservative abstention.

resource_policy: Compared systems receive matched LLM/tool/time/candidate budgets for the same motivating case. Fresh assurance uses the same frozen fresh set/evaluator for all systems; a method may not consume the protected fresh set as training feedback before its final fresh verdict.
exclusion_policy: Failed, null, harmful, uncompilable, timed-out and blocked candidate variants remain in the archive. Only symmetric predeclared infrastructure outages may be excluded from the primary denominator, and their records remain retained.

statistics.unit: hidden-cause development episode with motivating/replay/fresh bundle; repeated stochastic improvement runs nested within episode/system
statistics.interval: Wilson 95% intervals for transfer/harm/compromise rates; paired percentile bootstrap (10000 resamples) for matched improvement differences; worst-family/tail regressions reported separately
statistics.multiplicity: Single primary fresh-improvement hypothesis with harmful-transfer guard; Holm correction for inferential secondary attribution/governance families
statistics.practical_margin: Design target: at least +0.05 absolute protected fresh-task improvement versus the strongest matched baseline; harmful-transfer rate may not worsen by more than +0.02 absolute. Catastrophic fresh regressions are reported separately and are not averaged away.

access_policy.hidden_labels: Root-cause labels, fresh-task answers and protected evaluator internals are hidden from candidate systems.
access_policy.evaluator_custody: Fresh evaluator/holdout is frozen outside challenger write authority before candidate generation. Self-verification cannot satisfy the publication gate.
access_policy.search_contamination_policy: Search/retrieval access to benchmark answers or fresh labels is logged and may invalidate the affected evidence record.
access_policy.access_logging: Candidate patch, sandbox, evaluator/holdout, file and search accesses are retained; negative-history deletions/modifications are detectable.
